verdict.rationale: Tavily provides an official Python SDK (tavily-python on GitHub, installable via pip) with well-documented methods for search, extract, crawl, map, research, Q&A, and RAG context retrieval, plus keyless trial mode and clear API-key setup docs. Strong first-party docs plus independent corroboration via the public GitHub repo confirm real, buildable SDK support. Missing for 10: no explicit mention of official SDKs beyond Python (e.g., JS/TS SDK) and no discoverable OpenAPI spec for broader multi-language client generation.
